thread:
Alex (Marketing): Hey team — we need a compact asset pack for the inference economics launch next week. Main ask: benchmark visuals + email hero variants for segmented nurture. Priority: hero + email hero + 1pg benchmark diagram. Delivery target: comps in 48h, final exports in 5 days. Can you take this?

Maya (Design): Got it. Quick Q — what segments are we targeting for email? Also any strict size requirements or animation?

Alex (Marketing): Segments: Enterprise (SRE/platform leads), Mid-market (product/engineering PMs), Startups (founders/ICs). Email hero should have 3 copy variants and 2 CTAs (Demo / Try API). Light motion ok for web hero but emails need static PNG/JPG.

Julian (Creative Ops): We can produce modular templates (Figma + flattened exports). Do you want localized color variants for APAC? Also pointer: we should handoff a small Figma component library so sales can swap numbers for mid-market demos.

Alex (Marketing): Yes APAC color variant required (dark BG option + light). Also include a version with short stat overlays for social cards. Figma link: https://figma.com/file/FAKE-REDSHIFT/inference-launch (wip)

Maya (Design): Cool. Posting quick spec block here for clarity:

```
Asset spec (first pass):
- Email hero: 600x200 (desktop-safe 600x300), PNG/JPG, 3 copy lanes
- Social hero: 1200x628 PNG, 1:1 microtile 600x600 SVG
- Benchmark 1-pager: 8.5x11 PDF + 1080x1920 slide PNG
- Slide hero: 1920x1080 PDF, include component variants
- Exports: @2x for retina where applicable
```

Maya (Design): Also need approved messaging snippets for each segment (1-liners). Can @Alex supply?

Alex (Marketing): Draft snippets:
- Enterprise: "Serve more requests at predictable cost — Redwood Dedicated for low-latency SLAs."
- Mid-market: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower per-token costs."
- Startups: "Get production-grade inference without the ops burden — fast API, fair pricing."

Isabel (Legal): Quick flag — any comparative or percentage claims (e.g., "50% cost savings") must be backed by an internal benchmark doc or be phrased as "up to". Send the data source link for copy that references savings. Also run brand-safe phrasing through legal before final.

Alex (Marketing): Noted. No absolute savings claims in first wave. I'll attach benchmark dataset and internal perf summary in the next message.

design-bot: Created task D-3217 "inference-launch-visuals" and added Maya, Julian, Alex. Due dates set: comps 48h, final 5d.

Maya (Design): I can start comps tonight. Will provide 3 email hero comps x 3 copy lanes + 2 social hero options first. Any mandatory fonts or brand tokens?

Julian (Creative Ops): We should also include a modular CTA module so marketing can swap Demo / Try. I'll add it to the Figma lib.

Alex (Marketing): Brand tokens: Redwood Sans (primary), Accent palette: #4B7CFF (blue), #12C48D (green), neutral greys in figma file. Use Icon set: /icons/redwood (in figma). Please run final through brand-guardrail checklist: color contrast, logo clearspace, no altered logos.

Maya (Design): Understood. I'll annotate each comp with which segment it's for and include alt-text suggestions for accessibility.

Isabel (Legal): Once first comps are up, ping legal for a quick sweep. We can usually turn around minor phrasing fixes in <24h.

Alex (Marketing): Great — thanks. Final timeline: comps by 48h (173774 (approx) but use D-3217 due), internal review day 3, legal sweep day 4, final exports day 5. If anything blocks, escalate here.

Maya (Design): 👍 starting now. Will post initial screenshots in the thread and the Figma invite to anyone missing access.

Julian (Creative Ops): I'll prep template export scripts and a readme for sales usage.

Alex (Marketing): Appreciate it — go for it!
